heat_elec.note: only 8 metered buildings: too few for model selection; the service uses their median

scheme.target: log(weather-normalized intensity from the building's own change-point fit)
scheme.metric: median |exp(pred − y) − 1| (median absolute % error), used for tuning AND reporting
scheme.outer_cv: RepeatedKFold(5 folds × 5 repeats, seed 0): measures only
scheme.inner_cv: KFold(5) inside each outer training split: tunes hyperparameters (grid or 40-draw random search)
scheme.selection: one-standard-error rule across families (simplest within 1 SD of the best mean)
scheme.final_fit: chosen family re-tuned on all buildings (inner RepeatedKFold 5×3), then refit
